name: Radio
looksLike: round choices where only one can be selected
little circles with a dot in the chosen one
picking one option clears the other circle
definition: A set of mutually exclusive choices: choosing one radio button deselects the others in the same group.

notConfusedWith.difference: Allows independent selections; several boxes can be checked at once.

prompts.short: Add a radio group with labeled choices and one selection at a time.
prompts.detailed: Add native radio inputs sharing a name inside a fieldset with a descriptive legend. Give each option a clickable label at least 44px high. Keep native arrow-key and Space behavior, visible focus, and a clear selected state.

vue: a { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; min-height: 44px; }
label { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; }

a11yNotes: Group options using fieldset and legend
Use one shared name and a visible label for every radio
Preserve native keyboard behavior and visible focus
